# lila.nodes

Object API over the scene: handles that survive renames, attributes as properties.

```
loc = locator("Target", position=(0, 10, 0))
loc.translate = (5, 0, 0)
loc.rotate_y += 45
grp = group(loc, name="Rig")
for n in selected():
    print(n.name, n.world_position)
```

Every edit runs a command, so it is undoable and echoes like UI actions do.


```python

```

Add an attribute to this node only (addAttr), saved with the scene. type is an attributeType (bool, long, float, double3, enum, matrix, compound) or a dataType (string, stringArray, doubleArray, Int32Array, vectorArray); other flags are addAttr's (default_value, min_value, keyable, multi, enum_name, parent ...). ### Node.bake_array

```python
bake_array(mode='instance')
```

Turns this live array into a plain group holding its sources and a real object per copy: instances of the sources ("instance"), copies ("copy") or references ("reference"). Returns the group Node.

### Node.points_array

```python
points_array(base=False, world=False)
```

(N, 3) float64 numpy array of the points in points' order, read-only. A view of the mesh itself when it can be (object space, no deleted points), else a copy. base=True reads the base mesh under modifiers; world=True world space. Safe to read from any thread: it is a snapshot that later edits don't change.

### Node.face_arrays

```python
face_arrays(base=False)
```

(counts, points): uint32 numpy arrays of corners per face and every face's point indices in a row, so face i is points[offsets[i]:offsets[i] + counts[i]] with offsets = numpy.cumsum(counts) - counts.

### Node.normals_array

```python
normals_array(base=False)
```

(C, 3) float32 numpy array of normals per face-vertex (faces in order, corners around each face), as drawn.

### Node.uvs_array

```python
uvs_array(uv_set='uv0', base=False)
```

(C, 2) float32 numpy array of a uv set per face-vertex, in normals_array's order.

## array

```python
array(*items, mode='linear', count=5, offset=None, rotate=None, scale=None, axis=None, angle=None, angle_mode=None, rise=None, count_y=None, count_z=None, spacing=None, center=None, name=None)
```

A live array of the items (Nodes or names), which become its children: shown repeated in a row (mode "linear", by offset), around a circle ("radial", over angle about axis, climbing rise per copy) or in a grid ("grid", count by count_y by count_z copies, spacing apart), about center (default the items' pivot). count includes the original. The copies are drawn and exported as instances and follow every edit to the items. Returns the array Node; edit it through its attributes (array.count = 8) and bake it with bake_array().


## instance

```python
instance(*items, reference=False, name=None)
```

Instances of the items (Nodes or names): meshes sharing their mesh, so editing one edits all. reference=True shares only the base mesh and gives each copy a modifier stack of its own. Returns a Node, or a list for several items.
